_about: SELF-TEST FIXTURES. Hand-written replies (NOT model output, no model was called) that prove each machine check catches what it should and lets a good reply through. Each entry says which checks must fail (expect.fails). The runner reports an entry ok when it behaves as written. Real recordings from a live run sit beside this file.

entries.note: Tutor, mechanics: points to each place, names and explains the error, two unrelated labelled examples, never fixes hers

replies.reply:
The commas after "money", "expression" and "equal" each join two whole sentences. A reader meets a run-on there. A comma alone cannot join two complete sentences.
Example: She left early, the train was late. → She left early; the train was late.
Example: The soup cooled, nobody noticed. → The soup cooled; nobody noticed.
Which of your places match?
Read: Part 1.

replies.reply:
Three splices, most important first.
money, families → money; families (a comma alone cannot join two sentences)
expression, this → expression; this (the same)
Read: Part 1.
